skills.description: Coordinate a requested QA workflow across recording, knowledge, tests, automation, performance and reporting without loading unrelated stages.
Inspect QA prerequisites and install approved missing skill, agent, browser and recorder components in the selected workspace.
Operate browser/API tests using dedicated spawned Playwright browsers and inspect API traffic.
Record human flows in a dedicated spawned Chromium browser with step screenshots, console/network evidence and bounded file resources until the last window closes.
Summarize and name recorded flows with minimal clarification, maintain business knowledge, and create illustrated manual flow documents.
Inspect an entire existing automation framework and document architecture, data flow and CI without changing implementation.
Create versioned manual UI/API test scenarios with at least 20 distinct cases for each selected business flow.
Execute selected manual UI/API cases or existing native unit, component, contract, integration and end-to-end tests with truthful evidence and separate provenance.
Create or update a local automation framework for selected flows after manual execution evidence or an explicit prerequisite override.
Create or update k6/JMeter performance scripts and execute only a confirmed load profile for selected application flows.
Analyze functional and performance test evidence and score likely failure causes independently from severity.
Produce an engineering report from evidenced QA analysis with coverage, defects, thresholds and prioritized recommendations.
Route performance engineering and RCA/fix requests to focused specialists and product-specific MCP roles.
Coordinate full performance engineering from SLO/workload design through monitoring, bottlenecks, tuning proposals and retesting.
Define realistic performance workloads, documented SLO targets and comparable baseline criteria before load execution.
Align test/incident runs with bounded logs, traces and metrics across products while reporting missing links and clock uncertainty.
Diagnose latency, saturation, capacity and scalability bottlenecks using correlated workload and system evidence.
Plan and evaluate regression/performance retests of approved fixes against comparable baselines and stability criteria.
Investigate QA failures and production incidents, establish causal mechanisms and distinguish suspected/probable/confirmed causes.
Prepare an evidence-backed code/configuration fix or tuning proposal with reviewable patch, rollback and validation before implementation approval.
Apply only an explicitly approved RCA/tuning proposal, validate the change and prepare a comparable retest without automatic deployment.
Discover approved Splunk MCP capabilities and retrieve bounded environment-scoped log/search evidence for performance or RCA.
Discover Dynatrace MCP tools and retrieve bounded DQL, entity, problem, metric and trace evidence for engineering investigations.
Discover NeoLoad Web MCP actions and read results or execute an explicitly approved NeoLoad run profile.
Prepare and, after explicit approval, create/update evidence-linked Jira issues using discovered project metadata and duplicate checks.
Prepare application knowledge, performance/RCA documents and runbooks, then publish version-aware Confluence changes after explicit approval.
Investigate AppDynamics application, transaction, snapshot and metric evidence through discovered MCP tools or scoped official API/export fallbacks.
Investigate Datadog APM, logs and metrics through the observability MCP server or scoped official API/export fallbacks.
Inspect, create or update JMeter JMX plans, prepare approved CLI load runs and assess JTL/dashboard evidence without migrating existing tools.
Coordinate full-stack functional and nonfunctional quality architecture, testing, defect investigation, RCA and evidence-backed enterprise solutions.
Map an existing frontend, API/service, data, integration and infrastructure stack with implementation evidence and deployment uncertainty.
Design full-stack functional quality strategy and trace business rules, state transitions, API contracts and data invariants to tests and reproducible defects.
Review full-stack threat boundaries and security controls, plan scoped verification and report reproducible vulnerabilities with remediation evidence.
Assess web accessibility through scoped automated and manual checks, evidence-linked criteria and practical frontend remediation plans.
Assess service and infrastructure resilience, failure handling and recoverability using measurable reliability objectives and scoped test plans.
Assess database, cache, queue and event correctness, consistency, isolation and migration risks with evidence-backed tests and remediation plans.
Propose compatible enterprise solutions and justified redesign options with measurable quality goals, tradeoffs, delivery stages and rollback plans.

official_playwright_agents.unsupported_native_hosts: reference-only; native acceptance must be verified

architecture_scope.strategy: assess-first-compatible-improvements; ask project strategy when consequential; redesign only with evidence-backed cost/risk justification
